title: Research: fixed-order T16 gain via a ten-helper repack
body:
## Summary

```diff
 exact PR3375 map, unchanged 144-call order and strict lift
- conditional kappa = 0.001673628681907313
+ conditional kappa = 0.001673628867926940
+ paid delta = +H2 -2H3 +H4
```

A two-helper swap followed by an eight-helper rotation moves two original helpers through one shared bin. The first swap makes the moment worse; the completed profile strictly improves it for every real `0<a<1` by concavity. Ten helpers relocate and 23 rows change including offsets. Exact gain over PR3375 is `186019627/10^18`.

This is a conditional fixed-order packing witness, with no optimum, selected-frontier update or complete multiplication theorem claimed. All inherited compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, analytic and bit H1-H5 premises remain. Concurrent PR3381 reports a larger gain using changed paired-call chronology and an extended lift; this preserves the exact PR3375 chronology and unchanged lift, with a different profile delta. That concurrent result is credited and is not replayed here.

Package `research/t16-ten-helper-repack` contains the literal program, proof, source pins, complete invoice and replay receipts. Canonical base is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6, refined `selected-packing` scope. PR3375 is retained at exact `62fd8039cc40749cea6238e7807db9a63b4d6765`; no pending Git object or solver is needed. Sources, limits, credit and open next questions are in its README and proof.

## Evidence

- Before: two rank-three idle children. After: one rank-two and one rank-four child, with unchanged rank mass 1,041,408 and deficit 5,120. Both complete intermediate and final maps pass the independent 69,120-role audit.
- All eleven unchanged strict admission stages pass, including 69 admission, 12 bit-supplier, 15 controller and 6 independent T16 controls, plus 11 owner controls. Both exact supplier engines, both seven-step bootstrap paths and all 47 outer inequalities pass. The complete typed physical invoice is equal except for three authenticated source identifiers. Prefix 397 stays paid at 512; row coefficient 16,469 stays fixed.
- The first attempt rejected a stale chart nomination 10005 because the actual audit gives 10004. Corrected candidate metadata passes a fresh full run. No checker condition changed.
- Standard-library Python 3.12 registered replay passes; ten behavioral groups pass normally and optimized; a separate direct reconstruction agrees on every final row. Ruff E/F/B/SIM, metadata/source pins, whitespace, committed-byte and source-history checks pass. A fresh Git-free committed-export replay also passes with exported bytes unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-ten-helper-repack
```

No hosted CI, fresh full cold native reconstruction, independent human review or formal-kernel proof is claimed. Credit Pierre/hexapode, Nick Petalas, Gonzalo Mier, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained compiler/owner/bit/moment lineage. Original notices remain. The proof gives the full attribution and evidence boundary.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One new scoped package. Selected records, suppliers, frozen inputs and shared checkers are unchanged.
